corrections.decision: Keep basic triangle forward path, legacy terminology labeled. Do not call it the only current pipeline; pixel shader/color output not mandatory in every depth-only pass.

Frame/depth surfaces discussed are image-shaped; not all GPU buffers are pixel rectangles. Separate constructing and presenting, not claiming double buffering eliminates tearing without synchronization.

corrections.topic: depth z vs z/w and clear
corrections.decision: Use mapped post-perspective depth; clear/compare matched with convention. A strict LESS test at depth1 need not pass far endpoint despite first fragment claim.
Provided tangent is chosen path, not sole possibility. Basis supports tangent-space normal mapping; skinned example has no lightmap UV. Four bones is example capacity.

Clipping before divide in homogeneous coordinates. Source statement 1/2 output vertices impossible is not robust at tangent/degenerate boundaries; reject fewer than3 unique non-collinear vertices/zero area.
Front winding is configurable independently of world handedness; mirror determinant may reverse winding.
One coverage per shared boundary is selected raster rule, not universal one fragment per pixel; account samples/overdraw. Alpha discard vs blending and optional depth writes separate.
Do not claim all present HLSL=Cg. Modern display uses SV_Position/SV_Target and Texture2D.Sample/SamplerState while preserving source example roles.
Use float3 L, explicit .xyz; w0 directions exclude translation; normalize xyz not float4 position. Guard zero vectors. Inverse transpose for nonuniform normal transform.

Interpolated pre-normalized L/H and attenuation differ from per-pixel nonlinear evaluation; move clamp after interpolation only under declared approximation. Historical 25/33 instruction slot comparison not current performance evidence.
No unconditional fastest manual unroll claim. Keep three-light accumulation and require target measurement.
Decode linear normal data, renormalize sampled N; transpose=inverse only for orthonormal TBN. Reorthogonalize skinned basis; normal blending stays stated approximation.
byte4 undefined legacy shorthand; use compatible uint4/input format in modern example. Array contains bone matrices. MAX_BONES40 and column storage are selected choices.
Check current author sites; omit unsupported future-PDF/news/edition statements, retain theory+practice reading roles. Author Pharr spelling correct.

Use 640×480→4:3/16:9 as explicit hypothetical rather than unverified all-Wii pipeline fact. PAR=display/sample, viewport physical aspect. Show chosen column-vector GL RH and D3D LH matrices with endpoint checks; not mandatory API handedness.
Round8bit encode; normalize decode and Gram–Schmidt rounded basis before transform. Results approximations. All4 inputs preserved; algorithms and computed results stored.
